shared_elements: carved relief within a rounded/oval outer frame or border
boat-like curved vessel form at the lower part of the composition
cross-hatched or lattice infill used as texture on part of the design
justification: Both surfaces are relief carvings enclosed by a rounded framing outline and both include a curved boat-like element in the lower zone plus areas of lattice/cross-hatch infill, but these are generic correspondences. A shows a seated anthropomorphic figure with headdress, arms and detailed garment rendered in naturalistic curvilinear relief, while B is a purely abstract geometric scheme of a hatched rectangle bisected by a vertical bar above a crescent with discs, with no figures at all.
